entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Group of black mages seeking artifacts in Phyrexia, later enslaved by Gix as priests of Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Brothers' War combatant whose atrocities the Brotherhood sought protection against.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brothers' War combatant alienated from his supporters and compleated.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War between Urza and Mishra on Dominaria.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Enslaved the Brotherhood as priests of Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian whose priests the Brotherhood became.

entities.name: Archmandrite of the Ivory Tower
entities.description: Invited the Brotherhood to join the Union of the Third Path; undone by their betrayal.

entities.name: Union of the Third Path
entities.description: Group the Brotherhood was invited to join and later betrayed.

entities.name: Fall of Terisia City
entities.description: Fall of the city after the Brotherhood opened its gates to Mishra's armies.

entities.name: Battle of Teonacall
entities.description: Battle in which the Brotherhood's abbey was destroyed.

entities.name: Society of Mishra
entities.description: Group carrying on the Brotherhood's philosophy during the Phyrexian Invasion.

events.summary: The Brotherhood, influenced by a Yawgmoth Demon, was enslaved by Gix as priests of Yawgmoth.
events.quote: they finally were enslaved by Gix as priests of Yawgmoth

events.summary: The Brotherhood betrayed the Third Path and opened Terisia's gates for Mishra's armies, causing the Fall of Terisia City.
events.quote: the Brotherhood betrayed the Third Path and opened the Terisia's gates for Mishra's armies

events.summary: At the Battle of Teonacall the abbey was destroyed and its abbots scattered, ending the Brotherhood's presence in Dominaria.
events.quote: At the Battle of Teonacall, the Brotherhood's abbey was destroyed and its abbots scattered
